notes: The second clause is an idiom recast, but the ASV spends separate words on the verb and on the accusative noun, so rule 2 splits them rather than rule 30 fusing them.
Both verbs are read as light verb plus complement and head on *feeble* and *weak* (rule 44); the supplied *as* before *water* belongs to the adverbial accusative under rule 33.
The article on הַיָּדַיִם is unrepresented because the ASV writes only *All hands* (rule 29).
